text:
Maria: Heads-up — planning to enable polaris-7b-quant in the model catalog tonight during the 23:30 UTC change window. Staged canary then regional fanout. Please confirm ops/infra/SRE readiness.
aj: ACK, reserving 10 dedicated slots in eu-west-1 (reserved capacity). Will post slot IDs when done.
Sam: I can own monitoring. I already added a dashboard and alert group for p95/5xx drift.
Ben: Quick question — fallback ordering and TTLs? We should be explicit so deploybot can orchestrate evictions cleanly.
Maria: Proposed fallback order (highest priority first):
```
- polaris-7b-quant
- polaris-7b-fp16
- comet-13b
- falcon-7b
```
Rollback trigger (proposal): 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m OR p95 latency increase > 1.2s over baseline for 5m. If triggered, immediate pin to polaris-7b-fp16 and revert traffic.
aj: slot IDs: slot-eu-001, slot-eu-002...slot-eu-010 (reserved). Confirmed burst capacity +2 nodes if memory headroom < 12%.
deploy-bot: Preflight checks scheduled at 23:15 UTC. Running catalog-preflight v2. Steps: schema/compat, quant-compat, perf smoke.
ops-runbook-bot: Note: rollout thermostat enabled. If rollback occurs, the thermostat will hold at 0% traffic for 2m to avoid oscillation.
Sam: Alert names: model_5xx_rate_eu, model_latency_p95_eu. I'll attach runbook links to both.
release-coordinator: Release notes uploaded: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-21/polaris-enable — includes perf baseline and QA signoffs.
Ben: TTL debate: currently set fallback TTL = 30m (so a model variant stays pinned for 30m after failover). I think 15m would be safer for rapid rollbacks.
Maria: Keep 30m for this rollout — we want stability after a failover. Short TTL caused flip-flop on the last enable.
aj: Deploybot preflight results: one warning — nodepool memory marginal (85% used on slot-eu-007). I bumped capacity and retriggered preflight.
deploy-bot: Preflight DONE at 23:18 UTC — warnings cleared. Canary rollout plan: 1% traffic -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% regional, with 10m observation windows.
Maria: Canary metrics to watch: output quality (eval set), p95 latency, 5xx rate, token cost spike. Sam please watch and call rollback if thresholds hit.
Sam: Roger. I will post in this thread at each ramp step (1%, 5%, 25%).
ops-runbook-bot: Rollback quick commands (for oncall):
```
# pin catalog to safe variant
redwoodctl catalog pin --model polaris-7b-fp16 --catalog-version 2026-03-21T23
# force-evict canary instances
redwoodctl runtime evict --tag polaris-7b-quant --region eu-west-1
# throttle traffic back to 0%
redwoodctl routing set --model polaris-7b-quant --traffic 0
```
Maria: Also share contact list: Sam (oncall), aj (infra), Ben (model owner), Maria (release lead). If rollback happens, we'll have an immediate postmortem.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 23:30:15 UTC — 1% traffic routed to polaris-7b-quant in eu-west-1.
Sam: 23:36 UTC — p95 up 80ms, within acceptable bounds. No 5xx. Proceeding to 5%.
aj: infra note — slot-eu-007 still high mem but within safety after bump.
deploy-bot: Ramp to 5% at 23:45:02 UTC.
Sam: 23:51 UTC — p95 +300ms on a small subset of prompts; running quick eval set. No 5xx spike. Holding for 10m as planned.
Ben: Adding a temporary routing exception for long-context jobs (will route to polaris-7b-fp16 regardless) — avoid tail-latency surprises.
Maria: Good call. Please document exception in the release notes link.
release-coordinator: Document updated with routing exception.
Sam: 23:59 UTC — evaluation shows slight regressions on 4 prompts; mitigations discussed in thread. I recommend proceeding to 25% but enable shorter guard timers (5m observation) for those routes.
Maria: Proceed to 25% with guard timers shortened for flagged routes. Keep the rest at 10m.
deploy-bot: Ramp to 25% at 00:05:40 UTC.
Sam: 00:12 UTC — p95 stable, no 5xx. Cost spike ~+4% token cost (expected).
Maria: If anything goes wrong, use the ops-runbook-bot commands above. Ben/Sam/aj standby for immediate rollback.
aj: slot reservations verified through 01:30 UTC in case of manual interventions.
deploy-bot: Full regional rollout scheduled for 00:40 UTC if no flags.
Sam: I'll post final thumbs-up at 00:30 UTC.
Maria: Thanks everyone — ping me if you see anything odd.
Sam: 00:30 UTC — thumbs up, proceed to full regional rollout at 00:40 UTC.
deploy-bot: Starting regional fanout at 00:40:12 UTC. Routed remaining 75% to polaris-7b-quant across eu-west-1 and eu-central-1.
Maria: Release complete. Will open a short follow-up postmortem tomorrow morning with latency/cost/quality charts.
release-coordinator: Added rollout tags and notes in the release page.
Ben: small follow-up: consider lowering fallback TTL to 20m for next rollouts, we can iterate.
Maria: Noted for next enablement. Great job. :tada:
